notes.title: Exertion – Demo Update v0.2.0
notes.notes:
🎮 New Playable Characters
Three brand new characters have joined the roster – each equipped with unique special abilities that bring fresh tactics and gameplay variety.

🔫 Weapon Visuals Overhauled
All weapon models have been visually revamped for a more impactful look and feel.
The weapon shop interface has also received a stylish redesign for easier navigation.

📜 Quest Panel Rework
The quest panel has been updated for better clarity and smoother progression tracking.

🖥 UI Improvements & Bug Fixes
Numerous UI enhancements have been made to streamline the user experience.
Comprehensive bug checks were conducted to ensure a more stable and polished demo.



🔹 Your Feedback Matters!

Join the discussion on our Steam Community page or hop into our Discord server – we’d love to hear from you!

notes.title: Exertion - Demo Update v0.1.3
notes.notes:
🚀 New Systems & Improvements

Drone spawn system has been tested and upgraded for more consistent and dynamic behavior.

🛠 Updates & Fixes

Integrated FSR 3.1 and Frame Generation for smoother performance.
Polished UI for a cleaner and more intuitive experience.
Fixed bugs related to XP spawn and the Chaos Wall.
Post-processing tweaks for enhanced visual quality.

🎵 Immersion Enhancements

Background music now plays when the card menu is open – for a more immersive feel.

🔹 We Value Your Feedback!
Share your thoughts with us on the Steam Community page or join our Discord server!

notes.title: Exertion - Demo Update v0.1.2
notes.notes:
🚀 New Features

Russian 🇷🇺, Chinese 🇨🇳, and Japanese 🇯🇵 language support added! You can now enjoy the game in these languages.

🎨 User Interface (UI) Improvements

Text fonts have been updated across the game, bringing a fresher and more refined look to the UI.
